payload.core_mechanism_summary: For each possible target vote count for party 1, the algorithm greedily purchases the cheapest voters from parties that exceed the target, then fills the gap with the globally cheapest remaining voters.
payload.rationale: The solution sorts all voters by cost and per-party voter lists by cost to facilitate greedy selection of cheapest options at each target threshold. This matches greedy sorting order, where sorted order is exploited to minimize total cost under constraints.
